cases.knowledge_desc: Target customers must be registered for at least 2 years with no overdue loans and hold a technology label.
cases.logic: register_years >= 2 AND overdue_loans_12m == 0 AND tech_label IS NOT NULL => approve

cases.knowledge_desc: Data matching rejects customers that fail hard eligibility thresholds such as minimum operating years.
If the customer holds large deposits and has no borrowing history, attribute as having no financing demand.
If rating is below B or cash flow is volatile, decline unless the venture is strongly VC-backed with a cash cushion.
cases.logic: rating < B OR cash_flow_stable == false => reject UNLESS vc_backed == true AND cash_cushion_months >= 12 => conditional_approve
